title: Keep a lab plan with a passkey, not an email
summary: Optional checklist at plan.labthrift.com. Username + passkey. No email recovery. Export before you wipe a phone.

start.body: Lab plan is an optional checklist for what you already have and where the first weekend sits. Prefer paper or a text file? Skip the app.

choices.label: I want the optional plan app

skip.body: Fine. Static notes on labthrift.com stand alone. House jobs still live on the house network.

what.body: Private workspace at plan.labthrift.com: list gear, tick weekend steps, sketch a closet, keep house names. Export anytime. Delete the account and the rows go with it. No accounts on the main site.

passkey.body: Pick a username — a handle, not an email. Sign in with a passkey (Face ID, fingerprint, or device unlock). No password. No phone number. No Google or Apple login.

recovery.body: No email recovery on purpose. No inbox means nobody resets you by guessing an address. Tradeoff: if every passkey is gone, the plan is gone. Export before you wipe a phone.

second.body: While signed in, add a second passkey on another device. Phone plus laptop is enough. Do this before you retire a phone, not after.
